audit.why: Shen owning 1-3 and the late game with Akali taking 6 and first item matches 46.42% Emerald+ over 2662 games and both on-disk charts. Charts untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: content early says Akali has 'no Shroud until 2', and breakdown.spikes gives her 'levels 2-3' and leaves Shen's level 6 unnamed.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is her W and cannot be learned before level 3, so the entry promises a reset tool a level before it exists. Shen's level-6 spike is Stand United at 200/180/160s and 35000 range - a global, which is why the content layer is right that following his channel is where a losing Akali lane still earns something.
audit.corrected: content early and whys[0] now say level 3; breakdown.spikes and breakdown.early rebuilt on level 3 and Stand United's 200s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer says four times that Shen 'heals' the poke back through Twilight Assault, and the full layer says to 'Shroud-dodge' Shadow Dash in five places.
audit.why: Riot's text gives Shen no healing at all: Twilight Assault is max-health damage and a slow, and his recovery is Ki Barrier, a SHIELD that gets its cooldown cut whenever he affects a champion. That distinction matters because it changes the item answer - a shield is baited out, not cut with Grievous Wounds. And Shadow Dash is a direction dash that taunts everything in its path, so it does not need to select Akali: the content layer already says correctly that it lands even inside Shroud, while the full layer told the reader the opposite five times.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the entry addresses Ki Barrier as an itemisation or sequencing problem, even though the _missing file flags this matchup shield-absorbs-burst on Ki Barrier and Stand United.
audit.why: Ki Barrier triggers after he casts a spell, and affecting a champion shortens its cooldown - so the shield is up more or less whenever he has been trading. The counterplay is sequencing, not anti-heal: make him spend a cast, let the barrier pop, then commit. phases[4].why already says this correctly; report[5].t and dontsFull[1].d did not.

notes: Shen has no healing in Riot's text — Twilight Assault is max-health damage plus a slow, and his recovery is Ki Barrier, a shield whose cooldown shortens every time he affects a champion. The content layer called it a heal four times, which points a reader at Grievous Wounds when the actual counterplay is to make him spend a cast and let the barrier pop first. The full layer also told the player to 'Shroud-dodge' Shadow Dash in five places while the content layer correctly says it lands through the smoke; both halves now agree.
